svg.title: Misclickas Spooky Bingo
svg.desc: A 6 by 9 Old School RuneScape Halloween bingo board generated from october-bingo-ideas.json.
svg.text: A CLAN EVENT FOR THE SPOOKIEST SEASON
MORYTANIA NIGHTS, CURSED LOOT, AND CONTROLLED CHAOS

g.title: The Six Brothers: 10 qualifying drop(s) required
The Voice in the Dark: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss. Virtus: mask, robe top, or robe bottom.
Rat King Rumble: 5 qualifying drop(s) required
The Mad Scholar: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Giants in the Green: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss.
The Drowned Crown: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Hive of Horrors: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Purple Portal: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Through the Vampire Mist: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Hungry Chest: Complete one requirement
The Wilderness Warlock: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Dreams of Ashihama: 1 qualifying drop(s) required

The Blood Theatre: (1x Scythe of vitur) OR (1x Avernic defender hilt AND 1x any of (Justiciar faceguard OR Justiciar chestguard OR Justiciar legguards) AND 1x any of (Ghrazi rapier OR Sanguinesti staff))
Heart of the Abyss: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Hounds of Hell: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Headless Harvest: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss. Virtus: mask, robe top, or robe bottom.
The Frozen Feast: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss. Virtus: mask, robe top, or robe bottom.
Web of Nightmares: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Crystal Prison: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Red Labyrinth: 5 qualifying drop(s) required

The Catacombs of Xeric: (1x Twisted bow) OR (1x any of (Dexterous prayer scroll OR Arcane prayer scroll) AND 1x any of (Ancestral hat OR Ancestral robe top OR Ancestral robe bottom) AND 1x any of (Dragon claws OR Dragon hunter crossbow OR Dinh's bulwark OR Kodai insignia OR Elder maul))
The Swamp Serpent: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
Demon in the Snow: 1 qualifying drop(s) required
The Crypt Keeper: Complete 50 Barrows chests
Grave Robber: Obtain a Skull sceptre from the Stronghold of Security.
Spooky Wardrobe: Complete the Halloween Holiday Event, or equip 1 full Skeleton outfit and earn 1 qualifying drop.
The Exorcist: Complete one requirement
FREE SPACE: BOO!
Arachnophobia: Defeat Sarachnis and obtain 1 Sarachnis cudgel
The Undertaker: Cremate 25 shades in Mort'ton, or burn 25 Chewed bones to send their spirits onward.
Revenant Hunter: Obtain 1 Ancient Emblem, 1 Ancient Totem, or 1 Ancient Statuette from the Revenants.
Bone Collector: Offer 100 dragon bones or better at the Chaos Altar.
Shades of Mort'ton: Open a Gold Shade Chest using a gold key in the creepy, infected town of Morytania.

text.tspan: using a gold key in the

g.title: The Grim Reaper: Teleport to Death's Office and successfully claim a Grave / Death reclaim while wearing a black cape.
Fists of Fury: As a team, complete 3 Barrows chests with no equipped weapons. Barrows damage may come from spells, prayers, or fists.
Ghostbusters: Complete a team Wilderness boss trip with every participant wearing at least one Ghostly robe piece.
The Witching Hour: One bonus point per board tile for a listed midnight drop
Zombie Apocalypse: Win a Pest Control game while every participant wears a zombie-themed outfit, or complete a raid room with everyone poisoned at the finish.
Spooky Scary Skeletons: Complete a Barrows chest or raid room while every participant wears a visible skeleton-themed item.
The Necromancer: Defeat a Wilderness boss while every participant uses the Arceuus spellbook and summons a thrall during the kill.
The Cursed Moons: Perilous Moons
Staff of the Old Ones: Chaos Fanatic / Mummies
The Buried Doom: Doom of Mokhaiotl
The General's War Spoils: General Graardor
The Reanimated Wyvern: (3x Vorkath's head AND 1x Dragonbone necklace AND 1x any of (Jar of decay OR Vorki OR Draconic visage OR Skeletal visage))
A Clash of Ice and Fire: Royal Titans

text.tspan: A Clash of Ice and Fire

g.title: Nightmare's Cursed Core: The Nightmare of Ashihama: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss.
The Leviathan's Maw: The Leviathan: Obtain any one listed drop from this boss. Virtus: mask, robe top, or robe bottom.
The Witch's Face: Cave Horrors
The Grotesque Guardians: Grotesque Guardians
The Pact Devil: Yama
The Corpse Eater: (1x Maggot marquess) OR (1x Elder venator fang AND 1x Crimson kisten)
The Fallen Seraph: (1x Aggy) OR (1x Jar of Light AND 1x Hallowfell)
The Pharaoh's Curse: (1x Tumeken's shadow) OR (1x Lightbearer AND 1x any of (Masori mask OR Masori body OR Masori chaps) AND 1x any of (Elidinis' ward OR Osmumten's fang))
